angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 4,289,604 km at 186.30 pc = 0.31 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3678 +/- 0.0225 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 186.30 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 6.166 (6.024 to 6.237) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 4,289,604 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.243 (2.182 to 2.305) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5340 +/- 171.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3282351760091020672: teff_gspphot 5340.111 K (16th-84th percentiles 5264.52-5607.894), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3282351760091020672: teff_gspphot 5340.111 K (16th-84th percentiles 5264.52-5607.894), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hoggar.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.209, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 28678 (pscomppars): spectral type G8 IV, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 5 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1999mctd.book.....H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 28678: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 28678 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.11 dex, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 28678 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.35984, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 28678 (pscomppars): age 1.8 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 28678 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.97 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...26J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
